text:
Predicates:
LoanedTo(x, y) ::: x was loaned out to y.
Footballer(x) ::: x is a football player.
PlaysFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
FootballClub(y) ::: y is a football club.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x was born in y.

Premises:
Ailton(Silva) ∧ BornIn(Ailton, 1995) ∧ Footballer(Ailton) ∧ LoanedTo(Ailton, Braga) ∧ PlaysFor(Ailton, Nautico) ∧ Brazilian(Ailton) ∧ FootballClub(Nautico) ∧ FootballClub(Braga) ∧ FootballClub(Fluminense) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is a Brazilian footballer, loaned to Braga, plays for Nautico, and Nautico and Braga are football clubs. Fluminense is also a football club.

Conclusion:
¬LoanedTo(Ailton, y) ::: Ailton was not loaned out to a football club.
